title: Air defence neutralises 126 Russian drones used to attack Ukraine overnight
summary: Ukraine's Air Defence Forces neutralised 126 drones that Russia used to attack Ukraine starting on the evening of November 17.

title: Ukraine's public sector deficit may rise to 17% of GDP in 2027 – European Commission
summary: Ukraine's public sector deficit is expected to remain elevated amid substantial war-related spending needs.

title: Russian army attacks Dnipro, Dnipro region, injuring six people
summary: Russian forces have been attacking the city of Dnipro and the Nikopol district of Dnipropetrovsk region with drones since the evening of November 17. Six people, including a child, were injured.

title: Russia loses 1,970 troops over past day in war against Ukraine
summary: The total estimated combat losses of Russian forces since the beginning of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, through November 18, 2026, amount to approximately 1,629,010 personnel, including 1,970 over the past 24 hours.

title: Kalibr missile strike on Kyiv apartment building: Ukraine issues in-absentia notice of suspicion to Russian vice admiral
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) and the Prosecutor's Office have issued an in-absentia notice of suspicion to Russian Black Sea Fleet Vice Admiral Arkady Romanov for his alleged involvement in directing Kalibr cruise missiles at a residential apartment building in Kyiv in July 2024.

title: Stefanchuk, Costa discuss prospects for opening final two EU negotiating clusters by end of year
summary: Chairman of the Verkhovna Rada Ruslan Stefanchuk and European Council President António Costa discussed in Brussels the possibility of opening the final two EU accession negotiating clusters for Ukraine by the end of this year.

title: UN Security Council to hold high-level meeting on Ukraine
summary: The United Nations Security Council will convene a high-level meeting on Monday, November 23, to discuss Russia's war against Ukraine.

title: Lubinets: More than 24,700 children remain in residential institutions in Ukraine, thousands more in temporarily occupied territories
summary: A total of 24,754 children remain in residential care institutions across Ukraine, while thousands more are in temporarily occupied territories.

title: Canada to allocate $120M in military aid to Ukraine
summary: The Canadian government has announced a new military assistance package for Ukraine, which will include ammunition, specialised sensors for air defence systems, military equipment and individual combat rations.

title: RMAs must ensure support and integration for evacuated residents of Oleshky community – Lubinets
summary: Regional military administrations must ensure proper support and integration into local communities for residents evacuated from Oleshky, in the Kherson region.

title: Cashless card transactions continue to grow in 2026 – NBU
summary: The number of cashless transactions made with payment cards in Ukraine rose 7.5% year-on-year in January-September 2026, while their total value increased 16.6%.

title: Prince Harry presented with book 'Unbreakable Kherson' during visit to Ukraine
summary: During his visit to Ukraine, Britain's Prince Harry was presented with a copy of the book “Unbreakable Kherson,” as well as drawings by a nine-year-old girl from Kherson that she made in a shelter.

title: Ukraine, Germany to launch joint production of unmanned ground systems – Pistorius
summary: Germany and Ukraine are setting up another joint venture to manufacture unmanned ground vehicles in Germany for subsequent delivery to the Ukrainian military.

title: More than 1,000 air defense missiles: UK announces £240M military aid package for Ukraine
summary: The United Kingdom is providing Ukraine with a £240 million ($316 million) military aid package, including more than 1,000 additional short-range air defense missiles and over a dozen air defense radars.

title: Banks' net profit down one-third in first nine months – NBU
summary: Ukrainian banks' net profit fell 33.3% year-on-year in January-September 2026 as the 50% profit tax rate weighed on earnings.

title: Three family members die from carbon monoxide poisoning in Kyiv apartment
summary: Two men and a woman from the same family died of carbon monoxide poisoning in an apartment in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district.
